title: Journey - Walking Through Grief - Day 2: Tears are heard

parts.style: warm, gentle welcome, slow and unhurried
parts.text: Welcome to Walking Through Grief. <short pause> This is day two, Tears Are Heard. <short pause> We began with three words for the road... walk with me. <short pause> Today is for everything you carry along it, that other people may have stopped asking about.

In the first days, people often ask to hear the story. <short pause> Then the world moves on, and you're left holding all of it. <short pause> The last conversation. The way they laughed. The small things only you would know. <short pause> It can feel as if you're the only one keeping the record. <short pause> David found that he wasn't, in Psalm fifty-six, verse eight.

parts.style: reverent, very slow, reading scripture aloud
parts.text: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?

parts.style: tender, soft, slow, resting between sentences
parts.text: God has a book. <short pause> What you cried is written in it, and what you couldn't cry. <short pause> So you can put the pen down for a while. <short pause> If you forget a detail, it isn't lost. <short pause> If you have a better hour, you haven't been unfaithful. <short pause> He remembers with you.

parts.style: slow, deliberate, each phrase landing softly
parts.text: Choose one thing about them that you don't want forgotten. <short pause> It can be very small. <short pause> How they said your name. What they always ordered. The shape of their hands. <short pause> Tell it to God slowly, as if He were writing it down.

parts.style: prayerful, slow, soft but clearly spoken
parts.text: Father, hear my tears as prayers. <short pause> Keep what I am afraid of losing. <short pause> Hold their story, and hold mine, and let me rest from keeping it all. <short pause> Remember with me. <short pause> Amen.

parts.style: soft, steady, slow sending, resting between phrases
parts.text: You can always return to these two prayers, however far you go on this road. <short pause> When you can't see Him... walk with me. <short pause> When you're afraid of forgetting... remember with me. <short pause> Your tears are heard. <short pause> Go softly.
